errors.text_span: В началото на графиката, стойността е около 2%, след което бързо пада до около -10% и се покачва до около 5%, след което отново рязко се покачва до около 6%, а след това рязко спада до около -12%.
errors.evidence: This description of the line's path is incorrect. The graph starts with a value close to 0%, not 2%. The subsequent sequence of peaks and troughs is also misrepresented; for example, the description omits the major peak of approximately +9% which occurs before the sharp drop to -12%.

errors.text_span: След това до края на графиката, тя варира между -5% и 5%.
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization that misrepresents a large portion of the data on the left chart. After the initial major fluctuations, the line continues to have values outside this range, such as a peak around +6% and a trough around -8%.
This is an over-generalization for the right chart. The line has several fluctuations that go below -5%, with troughs reaching approximately -7%.
The description omits the legends present below each chart, which label the lines as 'Real daily return' and 'Heston simulated daily return'.

errors.text_span: Лявата графика показва по-голяма волатилност, докато дясната графика изглежда по-стабилна.
errors.evidence: This statement uses interpretive language ('volatility', 'stable') to compare the two graphs, rather than providing a direct, factual description of the visual information.
